data.gender_notes: Anselmi is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Anselmi is recorded with the meaning “God's helper”. Anselmi is a Biblical name meaning “God's helper”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
